_comment: A budget the job fits inside. The whole loop costs a little under 2.4 million instructions, so this run never comes near the ceiling and the bound is invisible in the output.
_budget: Both fields are properties of the guest VM: instructions it may execute, kilobytes it may hold. Neither bounds wall-clock time -- a hostcall that parks for 85 seconds consumes no instructions -- and neither bounds how many children a lineage spawns.
